wp-block-post-content is-layout-flow wp-block-post-content-is-layout-flow"><p>Hello and welcome to April, a month full of inspiration and excitement for the whole family, and by &#8220;the whole family&#8221; I mean gay people looking for lesbian, bisexual and queer characters on their television screens!</p> <p>First, some business: I want to tell you that last month I didn&#8217;t know there was a lesbian character on <em>Jury Duty Presents: Company Retreat</em> but there is, and it&#8217;s a really great show. (Nothing will ever be as great as the original Jury Duty but these guys really did figure out a way to make it work again in a different scenario!)</p> <p>Some not-lesbian stuff I&#8217;m excited about: An adaptation of the novel <em>Margot&#8217;s Got Money Trouble, </em>about a young mother who turns to OnlyFans to support her baby, debuts April 15 on Apple TV, and I fired up the screeners looking for queers and although I didn&#8217;t find any explicit queer representation, I kept on watching regardless because I really enjoyed it! Furthermore, Dan Levy&#8217;s<em> Big Mistakes</em> drops on Netflix April 9th, and it&#8217;s not girl gay but it&#8217;s very very guy gay.</p> <hr /> <p><strong>The Valley: Season 3 Premiere // April 1/2 // Bravo/Peacock</strong><br /> Jasmine Goode and Melissa Marie will be having their lesbian wedding on this season of Bravo&#8217;s <em>Vanderpump Rules </em>spin-off.</p> <p><strong><em>Long Time Listener</em> (2026) // April 2 // AMC All BLK </strong><br /> This noir-esque suspense thriller centers on Genesis (Megan Holder) a (bisexual!) true crime podcast host who finds herself and her pod targeted by a scary &#8220;long time listener&#8221; who seems hell-bent on her destruction. Her co-host, Max, is also queer!</p> <h3><a href="https://www.autostraddle.com/xo-kitty-season-two-queer-review/">XO Kitty</a>: Season 3 Premiere // April 2 // Netflix</h3> <figure id="attachment_664191" aria-describedby="caption-attachment-664191" style="width: 1200px" class="wp-caption aligncenter"><img data-recalc-dims="1" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" data-attachment-id="664191" data-permalink="https://www.autostraddle.com/april-2026-whats-new-gay-streaming/xo_kitty_n_s3_e5_00_20_46_13r/" data-orig-file="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/XO_Kitty_n_S3_E5_00_20_46_13R-e1775146769583.jpg?fit=2200%2C1237" data-orig-size="2200,1237" data-comments-opened="1" data-image-meta="{&quot;aperture&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;credit&quot;:&quot;COURTESY OF NETFLIX&quot;,&quot;camera&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;caption&quot;:&quot;XO, Kitty. But her former crush Yuri (Gia Kim) is returning, as is Yuri&#8217;s ex Juliana (Regan Aliyah) and the girl Kitty fumbled her thing with, Praveena (Sasha Bhasin). <em>To All the Boys I&#8217;ve Loved Before</em> fans will be delighted to hear that the series&#8217; heroine Lara Jean — Kitty&#8217;s sister — will appear in multiple episodes of Season Three.</p> <p><strong>The Testaments: Season 1 Premiere // April 8 // Hulu</strong><br /> While Becka&#8217;s character was <em>very </em>subtextually queer in Margaret Atwood&#8217;s book, a sequel to <em>The Handmaid&#8217;s Tale</em>, the show seems to be playing it a little closer to the surface. Set four years after The Handmaid&#8217;s Tale, the show is set in a new, slightly reformed Gilead, and focused on Agnes (Chase Infiniti), a pious Gilead native and Daisy (Lucy Halliday), a rebellious newcomer, as they navigate &#8220;the gilded halls of Aunt Lydia&#8217;s elite preparatory school for future wives,&#8221; building a relationship with each other that will threaten everything Gilead holds dear. Becka (Mattea Conforti) is Agnes&#8217; best friend. Queer actor Rowan Blanchard plays Shunamite, a pampered, judgmental friend of Agnes&#8217;s.</p> <h3><a href="http://autostraddle.com/tag/hacks">Hacks</a>: Season 5 Premiere //  April 9 // HBO Max</h3> <p><img loading="lazy" data-recalc-dims="1" decoding="async" data-attachment-id="664190" data-permalink="https://www.autostraddle.com/april-2026-whats-new-gay-streaming/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones/" data-orig-file="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?fit=1920%2C960" data-orig-size="1920,960" data-comments-opened="1" data-image-meta="{&quot;aperture&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;credit&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;camera&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;caption&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;created_timestamp&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;copyright&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;focal_length&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;iso&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;shutter_speed&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;title&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;orientation&quot;:&quot;0&quot;}" data-image-title="hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?fit=1200%2C600" class="aligncenter size-large wp-image-664190" src="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=1200&#038;resize=1200%2C600" alt="hacks - leslie bibb and cherry jones" width="1200" height="600" srcset="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=1920 1920w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=640 640w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=768 768w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=1200 1200w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hacks-leslie-bibb-cherry-jones.jpeg?w=1536 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" /></p> <p><em>Hacks</em>&#8216; writers have had the last scene of the series planned since the jump, and I for one cannot wait to see it, but also am sad about it, because it is such a good show and I don&#8217;t want it to be over. Cherry Jones and Leslie Bibb are joining the cast in an arrangement that seems to be &#8220;lesbian couple.&#8221;</p> <p><strong><em>Outcome</em> (2026) // April 10 // Apple TV+</strong><br /> I&#8217;m not sure if she&#8217;s playing a trans character, but Laverne Cox is part of the cast of this black comedy following Reef Hawk (Keanu Reeves), a massive movie star looking to rehab his image after making heaps of enemies during his five-year heroin addiction. Cameron Diaz and Matt Bomer play his only remaining friends.</p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.autostraddle.com/christy-martin-movie-personal-essay/"><em>Christy</em></a> (2025) // April 10 // HBO Max</strong><br /> The streaming premiere of the biopic about America&#8217;s best-known 1990&#8217;s female boxer, Christy Martin (Sydney Sweeney), a lesbian who&#8217;s coach-turned-husband attempted to murder her after years of control and abuse.</p> <p><strong>Malcolm in the Middle: Life&#8217;s Still Unfair: Limited Series Premiere // April 10 // Hulu</strong><br /> Freddie Muniz returns as Malcolm for this four-part original series follow-up. Malcom is apparently no longer really in the middle — he&#8217;s got a girlfriend and a daughter and has gone no-contact with his family, until he&#8217;s roped back in for his parents&#8217; 40th anniversary. Nonbinary actor Vaughan Murrae plays Kelly, Hal and Lois&#8217; youngest child, who is nonbinary. zendaya2" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?fit=1172%2C900" class="aligncenter size-large wp-image-664189" src="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=1172&#038;resize=1172%2C900" alt="zendaya in a car looking surly" width="1172" height="900" srcset="https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=1920 1920w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=640 640w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=768 768w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=1172 1172w, https://www.autostraddle.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/euphoria-zendaya2.jpg?w=1536 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" /><br /> It&#8217;s been a minute since Season 2, and Season 3 is vaulting us five years into the future — where &#8220;a group of childhood friends [are] wrestling with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption, and the problem of evil.&#8221; Rue&#8217;s using again and in trouble with the law, Cassie&#8217;s engaged to Nate and addicted to social media, Jules is in art school, seemingly doing some sex work, and &#8220;very nervous about having a career as a painter and trying to avoid responsibility at all costs.&#8221; Maddy and Lexi are both working in Hollywood. New cast members include Sharon Stone, Danielle Deadwyler, Natasha Lyonne, Trisha Payta and Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje.</p> <p><strong>The Audacity: Season One Premiere // April 12 // AMC+</strong><br /> A dark comedy set in the Silicon Valley tech bubble plans to take on &#8220;the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future.&#8221; Nonbinary actor Jess McLeod plays pink-haired Harper and I&#8217;m gonna assume based on that name and the actor and the hair color that the character is indeed also nonbinary.</p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.autostraddle.com/from-season-2-finds-queer-love-in-a-hopeless-place/">From</a>: Season 4 Premiere // April 19 // MGM+</strong><br /> Focusing on the aftermath of town lore-related revelations, Season 4 finds Boyd trying very hard to keep the town together amid some steep odds. While our lesbian Kristi Miller was sidelined for much of Season 3 with a foot injury, we&#8217;re hoping to see her out and about with her wife Marielle this year in a season apparently described as &#8220;dark, twisted and instantly engaging.&#8221;</p> <button class="simplefavorite-button" data-postid="664179" data-siteid="1" data-groupid="1" data-favoritecount="0" style="">Favorite <i
